mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with increased wage pressures and reduced corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which historically correlates with increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increase > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances where INDPRO declines over 3 months.
